DEFECT-1 (found and fixed within the work order's boundaries — tests/integration/deployment/e2e-driver.test.ts + production-drill.test.ts): BOTH driver integration tests hard-required the non-skipped rollback both-directions drills in TWO places each — (a) stepOf on the drill steps + skipped toBeUndefined + rollbackTargetRevision 40-hex, and (b) the totals pin negativesTotal >= 13. Reproduction: run either file with rails on a branch whose HEAD legitimately changes deploy/manifests — (a) throws 'the driver report carries the step release-rollback-prerepoint-refused' because the drivers correctly record their documented honest-skip step instead; (b) fails 'expected 12 to be greater than or equal to 13' because the skipped rollback segment consolidates its steps (the prerepoint refusal — the 13th negative — is replaced by the skip). Both reproduced live in this session's first railed run (the (b) form on e2e-driver run 1 of 3). Root cause: a pre-existing test-contract gap, NOT a driver defect — the drivers (DEP-040/DEP-043) implement the honest-skip path for exactly this case, but the tests pinned only the drill-present outcome; the gap was invisible while every recorded delivery kept deploy/manifests byte-identical to base (DEP-040's own merge notes say so explicitly). Classification: test-contract defect in the deploy test surface. Fix: both tests branch on rollbackTargetRevision — when present (manifest-stable revisions) the ORIGINAL full both-directions assertions AND the >= 13 totals pin run unchanged; when absent the honest-skip step is pinned with its exact reason, rollbackTargetRevision is asserted undefined, and the totals pin accepts 12. Regression pin: the extended assertions themselves; on manifest-stable checkouts the full path is still strictly required.
